title: Content Security Policy and security headers
summary: MyAPES Account now sends a Content Security Policy and other security headers on every page. The policy starts in report-only mode so nothing breaks while it is checked.
changes: Add a Content Security Policy, X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy to every response.
The policy allows the TinyMCE editor and Microsoft Bookings pages that arrive in later releases.
Start in report-only mode and log any reported problems, so the policy can be enforced safely later.
Replace inline page scripts that a strict policy would block.
version_rationale: Patch: adds response headers in report-only mode and a report endpoint; no data change.
validation: New feature test for headers on every response, allowed sources, script nonces, enforcement and reports.
New frontend test for confirm and auto-submit actions.
known_limitations: The policy is report-only until CSP_ENFORCE is turned on in a later release.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No data changes.
provenance: Milestone v0.50.2 Beta, issue #485 under epic #481, pull request #620.
